content.introduction: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is a unit of the United States Department of Labor that serves as the principal fact-finding agency for the U.S. government in the broad field of labor economics and statistics. It collects, processes, analyzes, and disseminates essential statistical data to various stakeholders. The BLS is headquartered at the Suitland Federal Center in Suitland, Maryland, and its main address is 4600 Silver Hill Road, Washington, DC 20212-0002. The official website is www.bls.gov, and the phone number is 202-691-5200. The BLS also provides data tools and economic releases, including the U.S. Export Price Index, which showed a +0.6% increase in August 2026.
body: The Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is a unit of the United States Department of Labor. It is the principal fact-finding agency for the U.S. government in the broad field of labor economics and statistics and serves as a principal agency of the U.S. federal statistical system. The BLS collects, processes, analyzes, and disseminates essential statistical data to the American public, the U.S. Congress, other Federal agencies, state and local governments, businesses, and labor representatives. The BLS also serves as a statistical resource to the United States Department of Labor, and conducts research measuring the income levels families need to maintain a satisfactory quality of life. Finally, it was transferred under the Department of Labor in 1913, where it resides today. Starting in 1992, BLS was headquartered in the Postal Square Building near Washington Union Station.
